title: speccal: Calibrated Inference for Specification Curve Analysis
description: Inference and calibration layer for specification curve (multiverse) analysis: survey-design grid fitting, exposure-residual permutation nulls, a null-based criterion for defensible specifications, calibrated summaries and variance decomposition, a constraint test for composite indices, and boundary diagnostics for breakpoints.
